---
title: "Patch supplementary figures — permutation analysis"
---

## Overview

Generate supplementary figures for permutation analysis results. Loads pre-generated ggplot2 RDS objects for null distributions and p-value heatmap, applies consistent theming, and saves high-resolution PNGs as individual supplementary figures.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(patchwork, ggtext, install = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-theme

source(here("custom_func/theme_main_fig.R"))
set_pub_geom_defaults()

fs::dir_create(here("VAE_UMAP_comb/patch_figures/output"))
```

## VAE null distribution (path2D DPS, THR8)

```{r}
#| label: suppl-fig-vae-null-dist

fig_vae_null <- read_rds(
  here("VAE/lite/permutation/output/fig_tbl/threshold_8/fig_null_distribution_path2d.rds")
)

fig_vae_null <- fig_vae_null + theme_main_fig() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_blank()
  )
fig_vae_null <- rescale_layer_params(fig_vae_null, size_scale = 0.6, linewidth_scale = 0.6)

ggsave(here("VAE_UMAP_comb/patch_figures/output/fig_suppl_vae_null_distribution.png"),
       fig_vae_null,
       width = 6.5, height = 5.2, dpi = 600, bg = "white",
       device = grDevices::png)
```

## Permutation p-value heatmap

```{r}
#| label: suppl-fig-perm-heatmap

fig_perm_heatmap <- read_rds(
  here("VAE_UMAP_comb/output/fig_perm_pvalue_heatmap.rds")
)

# theme_main_fig() draws legend text with ggtext, whose label grobs report an inflated height
# inside a colour bar: the bar grew to 18 cm, ran past the 13.2 cm canvas and clipped its title.
# Plain legend text (replaced, since ggplot2 will not merge element_text into element_markdown)
# and a 0.8 cm key give a 4 cm bar with the "P value" title above it.
fig_perm_heatmap <- fig_perm_heatmap +
  (theme_main_fig() %+replace% theme(legend.text = element_text(size = rel(0.85), colour = "black"))) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.8, "cm")
  )
fig_perm_heatmap <- rescale_layer_params(fig_perm_heatmap, size_scale = 0.6, linewidth_scale = 0.6)

ggsave(here("VAE_UMAP_comb/patch_figures/output/fig_suppl_perm_heatmap.png"),
       fig_perm_heatmap,
       width = 6.5, height = 5.2, dpi = 600, bg = "white",
       device = grDevices::png)
```

## Verify output

```{r}
#| label: verify-output

output_files <- fs::dir_ls(
  here("VAE_UMAP_comb/patch_figures/output"),
  glob = "*suppl_vae_null*|*suppl_umap_null*|*suppl_perm_heatmap*"
)
fs::file_info(output_files) |>
  select(path, size, modification_time) |>
  mutate(path = basename(path))
```
